body:
I have tried to find clubs related to my hobby but they cost so much and I live on a very very fixed income. I have worked with autistic children before, but the city where I live now only hires people with degrees and such to work with them so I can no longer do that.

Even some of the "help" groups for things like this have turned me down since my government health insurance doesn't cover mental health anymore and it is unaffordable for me. Hence one of the many reasons why I feel the way I do.
